subject: English
question_text: Choose the correct answer from the alternatives: 1 7=7
stimulus: i. What is one of the major causes of air pollution in Bangladesh? A) Solar panels B) Brick kilns C) Water treatment plants D) Wind turbines ii. Which group suffers the most from pollution in Bangladesh? A) Urban dwellers B) Rural farmers C) Fishermen D) Tourists iii. What is a suggested way to reduce air pollution from vehicles? A) Increase fuel price B) Use CNG or LPG instead of petrol C) Drive faster D) Remove traffic signals iv. Which of the following is a source of water pollution? A) Erosion B) Solar energy C) Wind D) Noise v. What can cause pollution to spread quickly in water sources? A) Still water B) Low rainfall C) Flowing together of different water sources D) Tree plantation vi. What kind of waste disposal is harmful to water sources? A) Recycling B) Improper disposal C) Composting D) Reuse vii. What is the result of using pesticides in gardens before rain? A) Plants grow better B) No effect C) Chemicals wash into water bodies D) Air becomes cleaner Additional Questions: viii. What causes soil pollution from automobiles? A) Fuel leakage B) Car wax C) Tyre polish D) Windshield wipers ix. What happens if toxic substances are thrown on the ground near a water source? A) They evaporate B) They reach the water body and cause pollution C) They become harmless D) They help plant growth x. Which of the following contributes to both soil and water pollution? A) Pesticides B) Bicycles C) Solar panels D) Hand tools xi. Which practice helps reduce soil pollution? A) Recycling B) Littering C) Burning plastic D) Cutting down trees xii. What is a safer alternative to chemical fertilizers? A) Cement B) Natural fertilizers and compost C) Industrial waste D) Polythene bags xiii. What causes loss of fertility in topsoil? A) Car washing B) Deforestation C) House cleaning D) Rain xiv. What should the government do about brick kilns to reduce pollution? A) Close them all B) Increase taxes on them C) Relocate them away from human areas D) Paint them green xv. What is the impact of mismanaged polythene bags? A) They help plants grow B) They stop erosion C) They threaten the soil and drainage system D) They are biodegradable xvi. Why should old vehicles be avoided? A) They are expensive B) They are slow C) They release more pollutants D) They are too heavy xvii. What can be used to reduce vehicle emissions? A) More petrol B) Cold start C) Proper lubricants D) Larger engines xviii. How does deforestation affect the environment? A) Increases rainfall B) Causes erosion and pollution C) Reduces pollution D) Improves fertility ix. What is one of the main reasons for soil pollution in Bangladesh? A) Industrial waste B) Tree planting C) Bird droppings D) Public parks xx. How can people help reduce water pollution at the household level? A) Dump waste in rivers B) Dispose of waste properly C) Use more plastic D) Burn garbage
